Near-zero visibility in fog is expected. Light winds combined with saturated conditions under a ridge of high pressure is causing widespread dense fog over portions of southern Saskatchewan, southern and central Manitoba this morning. Visibilities will improve later this morning. Travel will likely be hazardous in some locations. Visibility will likely be suddenly reduced at times. Fog advisories are issued when widespread poor visibility in fog is expected. Please continue to monitor alerts and forecasts issued by Environment Canada.
